OCS-GE land cover and land use of the Metaleurop site

Source: R/data.R
ocsge_us_metaleurop.Rd

OCS-GE polygons of roi_metaleurop with both the cover (CS) and the use (US), dissolved into one multipolygon per (cover, use) pair. ocsge_metaleurop is dissolved by cover only and cannot be used to study the land use.

Usage

data(ocsge_us_metaleurop)

Format

An sf object (EPSG:2154) with 68 multipolygons and 3 columns:

code_cs

Character. OCS-GE cover code (e.g. "CS2.2.1").

code_us

Character. OCS-GE use code (e.g. "US1.1").

area_ha

Numeric. Area of the (cover, use) pair on the site, in hectares.

Details

Built from the 2021 OCS-GE of the Nord and Pas-de-Calais departments, as returned by get_ocsge_data_fgb. Outlines are simplified with a 3 m tolerance to keep the dataset small.

See also

join_ocsge_species, ocsge_species_dict

Examples

data(ocsge_us_metaleurop)
head(ocsge_us_metaleurop)
